title: Ideas, hooks, dedup và mobile capture
scope_items: Database Migration 00013: Extended ideas table with embedding_vector, source_class, confidence_band, and idx_ideas_workspace_status; created hooks table with workspace composite tenant key, tenant RLS isolation, foreign keys to ideas and workspaces, and narrow grants; reversible transactional down migration.

Acceptance Target 1 (Duplicate idea warns without silent merge): Semantic and lexical similarity calculation with >0.85 threshold. Returns duplicate warning with matched title and similarity score. Both user and client can inspect existing or proceed anyway, persisting distinct idea records without silent merging.

Acceptance Target 2 (Source lineage retained): Full provenance retention linking ideas to source objects (trend, opportunity, product, thread, comment_cluster, objection, offer, manual) via junction records. When source objects expire or are deleted, the lineage link is retained with an archive notice (EC-M05-002).

Acceptance Target 3 (Mobile title-only draft works): Quick capture supports title-only entry creating a draft idea without requiring description or suggested format. Automatic manual source attribution to creator (RULE-M05-001).

State Machine & Conversion: Enforced strict progression draft -> candidate -> selected -> converted | archived (RULE-M05-002). Guarded script conversion (EC-M05-004) requiring non-empty description and suggested_format before conversion.

Hook Bank Integration: Hook bank schema, protobuf contracts, and UI drawer component supporting question, shock, story, pov, listicle, and contrast hooks with effectiveness scores and source attribution (§6.3).
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_DuplicateIdeaWarnsWithoutSilentMerge (Go -race), Vitest unit tests (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm duplicate warning banner above 0.85 threshold and distinct record persistence.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_SourceLineageRetainedAcrossTypesAndExpiredSource (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm provenance retention across all 8 source types and archive notice preservation.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_MobileTitleOnlyDraftWorks (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter QuickCaptureSheet widget tests confirm title-only capture into draft status with manual source attribution.
State Machine & Conversion Verified: TestRULE_M05_002_StateMachineProgression and TestEC_M05_004_ConversionRequiresRequiredFields verify state transition constraints and script conversion validation.
Migration 00013 Verified: TestLoadAndValidateCanonicalP004Migration and TestUpStatusDownTransactionalBehavior pass for all 13 migrations including 00013 up and down execution.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, Dart analyze/test.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: check_node.sh (svelte-check 0/0, vite build, 114 web tests + 6 admin tests), check_web_smoke.sh (SSR HTTP 200 on /ideas), and check_flutter.sh (flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings + 102 tests) all pass.
external_gates: Local mock enrichment and prompt templates verified; production AI video/idea generation provider requires production LLM API credentials.
Clerk production environment and live webhook signing secret gate.
Migration 00013 SQL grammar, transactional up/down, and RLS policy contracts verified locally; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.
